_comment: Weave preset - seed. Entities first, then relations. Seeds the four Weave roles as Role nodes so RBAC and assignments have real identities to reference. Modules/tasks/CRs are created live through the governed actions or backfilled from the repo.

entity_data.description: Orchestrator and human entry point: intake, PRDs, the global task list, discussion docs.
Design authority: RFCs, READMEs, diagrams, task breakdown, code-review standards, merge.

Environment owner: runs the assembled frontend+backend+DB, integration/e2e tests, promotion.
